rows.notes: Drives CE scenario_fog_region_get_fog_index (scenario.c:1073) with synthetic palette and fog-definition data; palette count and entry fog index variations change output and match an independent Python oracle.
Per-region fog_palette_index set to NONE and in-range variants; CE scenario_fog_region_get_fog_index output matches the oracle.
Drives CE scenario_location_underwater weather palette validity with weather_palette counts 0..3. Palette element contents (particle_system, wind) are other members and not covered.

Byte retention: fog_unused and weather_unused poisoned (0xA5/0x5A) and consumer outputs unchanged; test_fog_unused_weather_unused_have_no_ce_accesses finds zero '.fog_unused' / '->fog_unused' accesses across the CE source.
Same evidence as fog_unused: poisoned span leaves output unchanged; zero textual CE accesses to '.weather_unused' / '->weather_unused' (structure_bsp_definitions.h:208).
Drives CE rasterizer_lens_flare_submit_for_cluster (rasterizer_lights.c:771) with lens_flares count variations (zero count reports 'lens flare' errors) and tag resolution; matches oracle.
Marker block count truncation and the 32640-entry capacity boundary driven; 'marker' error and break match oracle.
Marker lens_flare_index 3 and 255 with a 3-entry lens_flares block: CE reports 'lens flare' and skips; in-range indices submit with resolved definition.
Flare tag index -1, 5, 300: lens_flare_definition_get resolution passes through as CE does (NULL for -1 and 300).

Drives CE lights_distant_lighting_at_point (object_lights.c:2388) with lightmap_group NONE and valid indices: the environment-lightmap path runs only for a valid group; outputs match an independent oracle. Shading/sampling helpers are stubs mirrored in the oracle; retail data not used for this row.

Default lighting copied on no-hit and non-environment paths (object_lights.c:2411-2413) and used as the base of the hit path; ambient-zero selects default_object_lighting. Varied default values change output as oracle predicts.

Only consumer found is structure_render.c:622, which passes &material->lighting to the draw_transparent_triangles callback. The callback's reader is in the render path and is not driven; no member-exact evidence.

Output distant count is always 2 (object_lights.c:2335-2338 and the table). default_lighting distant_light_count varied to 7 with no observable effect, as CE does. Member is read by CE only via the copy and then overwritten.
Default point_light_count 0, 1, 2 flows to the output on no-hit and hit paths (object_lights.c:2296-2310 for the computed counts); matches oracle.

Partial: the CE normal decode (rasterizer_geometry.c:299, uncompress_int32_to_real_vector3d) matches an independent decode on all ~34k normal fields of retail compressed_vertex_data (beavercreek, boardingaction, damnation). Still missing: position/binormal/tangent/texcoord decode, and the PS2 converter leg, because docs/reports/m2-bsp-compressed-vertices-parity-audit.md states HP2 BSPn does not carry the packed normal/tangent contract. Blocked, not pass.

Only CE reader is render_debug_fog_planes (structures.c:628-690), gated by the debug_fog_planes flag and fog-normal render mode. Driven with 0, 3, 4 vertex and multi-plane cases; emitted edges match oracle. The grep for '.vertices' over fog_plane readers finds structures.c only; no gameplay path reads it.
Consumers are collisions.c:357 and :626. Owned by the collision lane; left as is per coordinator instruction.
